D.1: The actual geometric $\mathfrak S_3$ action excludes dimension two. Fully invariant finite five-group targets carry all three ordinary special outer parameters. Every first-precision parameter is class-preserving with an exact elementwise conjugator. All $A_6$ chief steps over an odd-order base have the proved equal positive generating-lift count, including coupled odd pullbacks. The ordinary even-base $A_6^{20}$ obstruction and all earlier lifting comparisons remain retained. Realization or exclusion of the two-dimensional complement through every finer full finite source remains. Every generating lift at the first universal coprime elementary-$p$ cover factors through an automorphism of that same cover; its complete fixed-conjugator fibre and ordinary centralizer union are parameterized and counted. Over every odd finite base, all pairing-compatible multiplier-one abelian lifts extend through the full relative pro-$p$ cover for every coprime prime. Their complete literal fibres and all-source factorization are proved. This retains all D.37 shadows for every $p\ne5$; the further mixed-prime finite extensions remain to be covered.
remaining_D_paragraph: 1. **D.1--D.2:** realize or exclude the extra directions in the full profinite sources. D.1 has dimension one or three, with dimension two excluded by its actual S3 action; D.2 has dimension one or two. D.36 now obstructs every nonidentity power of one specified order-five ordinary peripheral component after the full centralizer union. Its exact product comparison also has an admitted component above the same prescribed five-group shadow. D.37 now supplies actual fully invariant characteristic targets P_n and the complete three-parameter ordinary outer family. The current route must account for every finite component above these specified shadows before it can bound a rational leading direction. The elementary abelian and central obstructions, complete A5 lifting theorem, and cyclic/two-group outer-image lifting theorems remain part of the chief-step comparison. A cofinal lift or a full-source exclusion remains to be proved. D.40 and D.41 now control the full relative pro-$p$ cover over every odd finite base, including all pairing-compatible integral homology maps and every generating source lift. For D.37 this gives every coprime-prime relative cover with the same characteristic five-group quotient. The next comparison concerns actual even bases and successive extensions with kernels involving more than one prime; the extra symmetry equations for D.2 also remain to be imposed on these fibres.
